veg.n: Cab driver's pretzel, peanut and mushroom jerky mix
veg.make_ahead: Keeps 3 days in an airtight tin

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms thinly lengthways and toss with the soy, maple syrup and half the paprika.
Toss the pretzels, salted peanuts and cashews with the melted butter, the rest of the paprika and the sugar on a second tray.
Bake the mushrooms on a lined tray at 160C for 40 minutes, turning once, until dark and chewy. Add the tray of pretzels and nuts for the last 15 minutes.
Cool both trays.
Tip the mix into paper bags with the chewy mushroom strips.

veg.make_ahead: Mix the sauce up to 3 days ahead in the fridge; batter and fry fresh, as the coating goes soft if it sits

steps.text: Whisk the starch, flour and cold water into a thin batter and toss the cauliflower through it.
Heat the oil to 160C and fry in batches for 4 minutes, then rest on a rack.
Fry again at 190C until shattering.
Simmer the gochujang, soy, honey and crushed garlic until glossy.
Toss the cauliflower in the sauce and top with sesame.

veg.make_ahead: Shred the cabbage and make the chipotle crema up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; whisk the batter and fry the mushrooms just before serving

steps.text: Whisk the flour and cold lager into a batter.
Mix the sour cream with chipotle and lime juice to make crema.
Shred the cabbage and tear the mushrooms into thick strips.
Dip the mushrooms in batter and fry in the vegetable oil at 180C for 3 minutes, in batches, until crisp.
Serve in warm tortillas with cabbage, crema and lime wedges.

veg_af.make_ahead: Shred the cabbage and mix the chipotle crema up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; whisk the batter and fry the mushrooms fresh on the night

steps.text: Whisk the flour and cold soda water into a batter.
Mix the sour cream with chipotle and lime juice to make crema.
Shred the cabbage and tear the mushrooms into thick strips.
Dip the mushrooms in batter and fry in the vegetable oil at 180C for 3 minutes, in batches, until crisp.
Serve in warm tortillas with cabbage, crema and lime wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Mix the honey and mustard up to 3 days ahead; brown and glaze the sausages on the night

steps.text: Brown the sausages in the oil in a frying pan, turning often.
Add the honey and mustard and toss until sticky.
Spear on toothpicks and serve hot.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Crumble the smoked tofu into a food processor.
Blitz with the cream cheese, horseradish, lemon juice and black pepper until mostly smooth.
Toast the rye.
Spread on the toast and top with thin cucumber slices.

veg.n: Hatchet Harry's vinegar rice paper crackling
veg.make_ahead: Best eaten the same day

steps.text: Cut the rice paper into strips with scissors.
Heat the oil to 190C in a deep pot.
Fry a few strips at a time for a few seconds until puffed and crackling, then drain on paper towel.
Brush very lightly with malt vinegar while hot, then toss in the salt flakes and paprika.
Tip into paper bags.

veg.make_ahead: Sauce up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Slice the hearts of palm into thick rounds, toss with a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt and chill.
Mix the tomato sauce, horseradish, lemon juice and soy.
Shred the iceberg.
Serve the hearts of palm over the iceberg in martini glasses with the sauce and lemon wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Fill the day before, chill overnight

steps.text: Finely chop the mushrooms and onion and fry in a third of the butter with the thyme leaves until dark and dry. Stir in the soy.
Cook the rest of the butter with the flour, whisk in the stock until thick, then stir in the mushrooms and season with salt and pepper.
Chill overnight.
Roll into balls and crumb in beaten egg and panko.
Fry in the vegetable oil at 180C until deep golden.
Serve with grainy mustard.

veg.n: Lake Como antipasto with marinated artichokes
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours ahead

steps.text: Lay the artichokes and eggplant on a board with the burrata, halved figs, breadsticks and olives.
Drizzle with good olive oil and a squeeze of lemon.

veg.make_ahead: Make the miso sauce up to 2 days ahead, chilled, and rewarm over low heat; cut the vegetables and bread on the day

steps.text: Slice the fennel, capsicum and radishes and the bread.
Melt the butter in the oil over very low heat with the crushed garlic until the garlic is soft and sweet.
Whisk in the miso and capers until smooth.
Keep warm over a candle and dip the vegetables and bread.

veg.n: Miami Beach hearts of palm salad cups
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Shred the hearts of palm with a fork and pat dry on paper towel.
Finely dice the celery and chop the chives.
Mix the hearts of palm with mayonnaise, celery, chives, lemon zest and juice, paprika and the nori crumbled fine.
Spoon into baby cos leaves and serve cold.

veg.n: Zukovsky's blini with black lentil caviar
veg.make_ahead: Batter rests up to 2 hours

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast and warm milk and rest until bubbly.
While the batter rests, simmer the lentils until just tender, drain and toss with the soy and the nori crumbled fine.
Cook small spoonfuls of batter in butter until golden.
Top each with creme fraiche, a spoon of the lentils and snipped chives.

veg.n: St Petersburg mushroom and cabbage pirozhki
veg.make_ahead: Bake the day you serve

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, warm milk and some of the butter into a soft dough.
Prove.
Fry the mushrooms, cabbage and diced onion in a little butter until soft and golden. Stir in chopped dill, season with salt and pepper and cool.
Fill rounds of dough and seal.
Bake at 200C.
Brush with the rest of the butter, melted.

veg.n: Fig, smoky eggplant, olive and cheddar picks
veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Cut the eggplant into strips, wrap one around each fig half and dust with smoked paprika.
Warm the olives in a small pan with the orange peel and fennel seeds until fragrant.
Break the cheddar into shards and push everything onto toothpicks so nobody gets greasy fingers on the cards.

veg.make_ahead: Uncooked dumplings up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

ingredients.item: small tin water chestnuts, drained and chopped

steps.text: Mix the tofu, water chestnuts, ginger, mushrooms, soy and sesame oil.
Spoon into the wonton wrappers, wet the edges and pinch up the sides.
Steam in batches for 8 minutes. Top each with a dot of chilli oil.

veg.n: Highland oatcakes and dill cured beetroot
veg.make_ahead: Oatcakes up to 2 days ahead, airtight

steps.text: Mix the oats with the melted butter, salt and a splash of hot water into a stiff dough.
Press thin and cut into rounds.
Bake at 180C for 20 minutes and cool.
Slice the beetroot paper thin and toss with lemon juice, a pinch of salt and half the chopped dill.
Top the oatcakes with crème fraîche, beetroot and the rest of the dill.

veg.n: Black Prince rice paper crackling and scotch eggs
veg.make_ahead: Scotch eggs up to 4 hours ahead, crackling best fresh

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 6 minutes, cool in iced water and peel.
Squash the sausage filling around each egg, dust in flour, dip in beaten egg and crumb in panko.
Fry at 170C for 7 minutes until golden and hot through.
Cut the rice paper into strips and fry a few at a time in the same oil for a few seconds until puffed. Toss with salt and smoked paprika.
Serve with the crackling, pickled onions and English mustard.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, cover with a damp paper towel

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel and mash with the mayonnaise and dill.
Mix the cream cheese with the mint and spread on half the bread.
Top with thin cucumber and a second slice of bread.
Butter the remaining bread, fill with the egg and dill and close.
Trim the crusts and cut into perfectly straight fingers.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, cover with a damp cloth

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool and slice.
Slice the baguette into rounds and spread with butter.
Top each with potato salad, a fold of edam, a slice of egg, a gherkin slice and parsley.
Line them up neatly on a long board.

veg.make_ahead: Fry the crackers just before serving; stir the chilli lime dip together up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Heat the oil to 190C.
Fry a few crackers at a time for a few seconds until they puff up dramatically. Drain on paper towel.
Mix the sweet chilli sauce with the lime juice and serve for dipping.

veg.make_ahead: Mash the dip up to 2 days ahead and keep it chilled; coat and bake the cauliflower just before serving, as the batter goes soggy

steps.text: Whisk the flour, milk, garlic powder and a pinch of salt into a batter and coat the cauliflower.
Bake on a lined tray at 220C for 25 minutes, turning once.
Melt the hot sauce with the butter and honey, toss the cauliflower through it and bake 5 minutes more.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream. Serve the cauliflower with the dip and celery.

veg.make_ahead: Slaw and salsa up to 2 hours ahead

steps.text: Whisk the flour with the lager into a batter. Mix the sour cream with lime juice.
Dice the tomato and onion and shred the cabbage.
Pat the haloumi dry, dip in batter and fry in the oil at 180C for 2 to 3 minutes, in batches, until golden.
Warm the tortillas and fill with haloumi, cabbage, tomato, onion and the lime cream.

veg_af.make_ahead: Slaw and salsa up to 2 hours ahead

steps.text: Whisk the flour with the cold soda water into a batter. Mix the sour cream with lime juice.
Dice the tomato and onion and shred the cabbage.
Pat the haloumi dry, dip in batter and fry in the oil at 180C for 2 to 3 minutes, in batches, until golden.
Warm the tortillas and fill with haloumi, cabbage, tomato, onion and the lime cream.

veg.n: Hard Deck smoky mushroom cheese loaded fries
veg.make_ahead: Cook the soy mushrooms up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; bake the chips, top and grill just before serving

steps.text: Bake the chips at 220C until crisp.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil until dark and crisp at the edges, then add the soy and paprika and cook until dry.
Top the chips with cheddar and the mushrooms and grill for 2 minutes to melt.
Finish with sour cream, jalapeño and chives.

veg.make_ahead: Spread and salt the biscuits up to 2 days ahead, airtight; toast and sandwich just before eating, while the marshmallows are soft

steps.text: Spread half the biscuits with a little caramel and a pinch of sea salt.
Toast the marshmallows over a fire or under the grill until golden.
Sandwich each marshmallow with a square of milk chocolate between two biscuits and squash together.

veg.make_ahead: Tofu can marinate up to 1 day

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry, cut into strips and rub with the oil, paprika, cumin, chilli and a pinch of salt. Thread onto skewers.
Grill hot until blackened at the edges.
Mix the yoghurt with the garlic and salt for a dip.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, cover and keep chilled

steps.text: Mash the butter with the lemon zest.
Spread on the bread and top with smoked tofu, dill and capers.
Cut into neat squares.

veg.make_ahead: Mignonette up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Mix the shallots with the vinegar and cracked pepper.
Rest the mignonette for 20 minutes.
Slice the mushroom stems into thick coins, simmer for 2 minutes in a pot of water with the kombu and salt, then drain into iced water.
Lay the mushrooms in Chinese soup spoons on crushed ice with lemon wedges and spoon over the mignonette.

veg.n: King of the world cheddar and pickle sandwiches
veg.make_ahead: Boil the potatoes up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; slice the cheddar ahead too and build the sandwiches just before serving

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in their skins until tender.
Butter thick slices of loaf and fill with cheddar, pickle and mustard.
Toss the drained potatoes with butter and salt. Serve together below deck.

veg.make_ahead: Stuff the dates and wrap in eggplant up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; bake and drizzle with honey on the night

steps.text: Split the dates and stuff each with goat's cheese and an almond.
Cut the eggplant into strips, wrap one around each date and dust with smoked paprika.
Bake at 200C for 8 minutes and drizzle with honey.

veg.n: Coiled vegetarian sausage snake with mango glaze
veg.make_ahead: Coil the sausages on the tray up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge, and stir the cumin yoghurt up to 2 days ahead; glaze and bake on the night

steps.text: Lay the sausages nose to tail in a tight coil on a tray brushed with the vegetable oil, pinning with skewers.
Brush with mango chutney mixed with the chilli. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes.
Stir the cumin into the yoghurt and serve alongside.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Blitz the mangoes with the sugar into a purée.
Whisk the agar into a third of the purée, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes, then whisk back into the rest.
Cool for a few minutes, fold in the whipped cream and spoon quickly into dome moulds.
Set in the fridge for 4 hours.
Turn out and top with passionfruit pulp.

veg.n: Venice smoked tofu, fig and eggplant toasts
veg.make_ahead: Toppings up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Boil the potato until soft.
Blitz the potato with the crumbled tofu, milk and 2 tbsp of the olive oil into a rough spread.
Fry the onion in the rest of the oil until soft, then add the raisins and vinegar and cook for 2 minutes.
Toast the baguette slices.
Top a third with the tofu spread and parsley, a third with gorgonzola and fig, and the rest with eggplant and the sweet and sour onions.

veg.make_ahead: Shape up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Shred the hearts of palm with a fork and squeeze dry in a clean tea towel.
Fold with the nori crumbled fine, the mayonnaise, egg, mustard and breadcrumbs.
Shape into cakes and chill for 30 minutes.
Pan-fry in butter until golden and serve with lemon.

veg.make_ahead: Mushrooms up to 1 day ahead, reheat in their juices

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms thick and toss with half the garlic crushed, the rosemary leaves, fennel seeds and 3 tbsp of the oil.
Roast at 200C for 25 minutes, pour in the stock and roast 10 minutes more.
Fry the broccolini in the rest of the oil with the remaining garlic and chilli.
Pile the mushrooms, greens and provolone into the buns and spoon over the pan juices.

veg.n: Smoked tofu and cheddar snack plate
veg.make_ahead: Set out the crackers, cheddar, apple and pickled onions up to 2 hours ahead, covered; slice the smoked tofu just before serving

steps.text: Slice the smoked tofu thin and fan it out on a wooden board.
Add the crackers, cheddar, apple and pickled onions the way a mountain lodge would set it out.

veg.n: Jersey hearts of palm on toast
veg.make_ahead: Shred and fold the hearts of palm mixture up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; toast the bread and pile on just before serving

steps.text: Shred the hearts of palm with a fork and pat dry.
Fold with the mayo, lemon juice, chives, cayenne and the nori crumbled fine.
Toast the bread, butter it and cut into fingers.
Pile the hearts of palm on top.

veg.make_ahead: Fry the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead and keep them chilled; mix the batter and fry just before serving

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the butter for 3 minutes and cool.
Mix the flour, baking powder, egg, milk and the nori crumbled fine, then fold in the mushrooms.
Spoon into oil at 180C and fry until puffed and golden.
Serve with lemon and tartare sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Mix the batter up to 3 hours ahead in the fridge; dip and fry just before serving, best hot

steps.text: Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, egg and buttermilk into a thick batter.
Pat the frankfurts dry and push onto sticks.
Dip in batter and fry in the oil at 180C for 4 minutes until golden, in batches.
Serve with mustard.

veg.make_ahead: Better the next day

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms and onion in the oil in a cast-iron pot until golden, then stir in the paprika.
Add the beans, chipotle, molasses, tomato paste and water.
Simmer for 30 minutes until thick and smoky.
Serve in tin cups.

veg.make_ahead: Shape the cookie rounds up to 1 day ahead on a tray in the fridge; bake, sandwich and warm on the night

steps.text: Melt the chocolate with the butter, beat in the sugar and egg, then the flour.
Shape small rounds and bake at 175C for 9 minutes. Cool.
Sandwich pairs of cookies with a marshmallow each and warm for 1 minute to melt.
Roll the edges in silver sprinkles.

veg.n: Pelle's pickled eggplant and new potatoes
veg.make_ahead: Pickle the eggplant up to 3 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Cut the eggplant into finger strips, toss with the oil and roast at 220C for 20 minutes until soft.
Warm the vinegar, water, sugar and allspice until the sugar dissolves. Pour over the hot eggplant with half the red onion and leave to pickle for 1 hour.
Boil the potatoes with the dill until tender.
Serve the potatoes warm with the drained eggplant, a bowl of sour cream with chives and the rest of the red onion.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours ahead, wrapped tight

steps.text: Whisk the oil, vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper.
Split the rolls and drizzle the insides with half the dressing.
Layer with provolone, eggplant and artichokes.
Top with lettuce, tomato, red onion and pickled peppers, drizzle with the rest of the dressing and close.
Wrap each tightly in baking paper and halve.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel and halve.
Whip the yolks with the mayonnaise and paprika and pipe back into the whites.
Fry the haloumi in a dry pan until golden on all sides, then cool a little.
Thread the haloumi and pineapple onto toothpicks.
Pipe the cream cheese mixed with chives onto the cucumber rounds.
Serve on silver trays.

veg.n: Bodega Bay hearts of palm toasts
veg.make_ahead: Shred and mix the hearts of palm filling up to 1 day ahead, chilled; toast and assemble just before serving

steps.text: Shred the hearts of palm with a fork, pat dry and fold with mayo, lemon juice, chives, cayenne and the nori crumbled fine.
Toast the sourdough and rub with the cut garlic.
Pile the hearts of palm on top and serve straight away.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours, wrap tight

steps.text: Roughly smash the chickpeas with a fork and mix with the mayonnaise, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Pile into the rolls with sliced avocado and crisp cos.
Wrap tight in paper for the boat.

veg.n: Amity Island fried king oyster mushrooms
veg.make_ahead: Slice the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; soak, dredge and fry just before serving

ingredients.item: king oyster mushrooms, stems sliced into rings

steps.text: Soak the mushroom rings in buttermilk for 15 minutes.
Mix the cornmeal and flour and dredge the mushrooms.
Heat the vegetable oil to 185C and fry for 2 minutes, in batches.
Serve with tartare and lemon wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Tofu can soak up to 8 hours

ingredients.item: extra firm tofu, torn into bite-size pieces

steps.text: Soak the tofu in buttermilk for an hour.
Season the flour with paprika, garlic powder and salt and toss the tofu through it.
Fry in the vegetable oil at 180C for 4 minutes, in batches, until crisp.
Mix the honey and Dijon and serve with the tofu.

veg.n: Roast capsicum, cheddar and pickle toasties
veg.make_ahead: Grate the cheddar and pat the capsicum dry up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; assemble and cook on the night

steps.text: Butter one side of every slice of sourdough.
On the unbuttered side of half the slices layer the grated sharp cheddar, capsicum and pickles, then more cheddar. Top with the remaining bread, buttered side out.
Cook in a pan over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and melted.
Cut into fingers and serve with hot English mustard.

veg.n: Stovetop smoky maple pecan brown butter popcorn
veg.make_ahead: Candy the pecans up to 3 days ahead and keep airtight; pop and toss just before serving

steps.text: Toast the pecans in a dry pan, add 1 tbsp of the maple syrup and the paprika and stir until sticky. Cool on baking paper and chop.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot over medium heat, add the kernels, cover and shake constantly until the popping slows. Pull it off straight away.
Cook the butter in a small pan until golden brown and nutty, then stir in the rest of the maple syrup.
Pour over the popcorn and toss with the pecans and a good pinch of salt.

veg.make_ahead: Boil the eggs and make the yolk filling up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; pipe, brown the sausages and fill the celery on the night

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel and halve. Whip the yolks with the mayonnaise and paprika and pipe back in.
Brown the sausages in the oil, then simmer in the barbecue sauce and grape jelly until sticky.
Fill the celery boats with cream cheese and sliced olives.

veg.make_ahead: Fill up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Mix the tofu, mushrooms, wombok, ginger and 1 tbsp of the soy.
Fill the gyoza wrappers and pleat.
Fry in the oil until browned, add the water and steam under a lid for 4 minutes.
Mix the rest of the soy with the Chinkiang vinegar for dipping.

veg.make_ahead: Stack and pipe the marshmallows up to 2 days ahead, airtight; toast with the blowtorch on the night

steps.text: Stack two marshmallows on each skewer.
Pipe eyes and a smile on each with the melted chocolate.
Toast half of them with a blowtorch for the full effect.

veg.make_ahead: Rolls can be chilled up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Lay the pastry flat and spread with tomato relish.
Cover with the spinach and cheddar and roll up tightly from one edge.
Chill the logs for 15 minutes.
Cut each log into slices, lay flat on lined trays and brush with beaten egg.
Bake for 15 minutes until puffed and golden.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Whisk the agar and sugar into the cold grape juice with a squeeze of lemon, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes.
Pour into small round moulds and set in the fridge for 3 hours.
Turn out and top each with a dot of whipped cream.

veg.make_ahead: Filled tamales up to 1 day ahead, steam to reheat

ingredients.item: tins young jackfruit in brine (400g), drained

steps.text: Soak the corn husks in warm water.
Simmer the jackfruit with the red chilli sauce and a splash of the stock for 15 minutes, then shred with two forks.
Beat the masa with the shortening, baking powder and the rest of the stock to a soft dough.
Spread on the husks, add the jackfruit and fold.
Steam for 60 minutes.
Serve with salsa.

veg.make_ahead: Crumb the haloumi up to 3 hours ahead and keep it chilled on a tray; fry just before serving

steps.text: Set up a station: flour, beaten egg, then the panko mixed with the coconut.
Pat the haloumi dry and dip each piece in flour, egg, then the crumb mix.
Fry in the oil at 180C for 2 minutes, in batches, until golden.
Serve with sweet chilli sauce mixed with lime juice.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 hour ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Cook the sushi rice and cool.
Pat the tofu dry, dice and toss with soy, sesame oil, spring onion and chilli. Leave to marinate for 10 minutes.
Spoon the rice into small cups and top with tofu and cucumber.

veg.make_ahead: Steep and strain the spiced milk up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; reheat and whisk in the chocolate to serve

steps.text: Warm the milk with the cardamom and cinnamon until steaming.
Turn off the heat and steep for 10 minutes. Strain.
Return to the heat and whisk in most of the chocolate with the sugar and salt until smooth and frothy.
Pour into mugs and top with whipped cream, marshmallows and the rest of the chocolate grated over.

veg.make_ahead: Best served straight away

steps.text: Cut the watermelon into small cubes and pat dry on paper towel.
Toss with soy, sesame oil, spring onion and chilli and leave for 5 minutes.
Spoon onto rice crackers and serve straight away.

veg.make_ahead: Fill up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Mix the tofu, mushrooms, garlic chives, ginger and 1 tbsp of the soy.
Fill the dumpling wrappers and pleat.
Steam for 8 minutes.
Serve with the rest of the soy and the Chinkiang vinegar, and pour the tea carefully.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Cook the rice and season with vinegar and sugar. Cool.
Fry the tofu batons in the oil until golden, add 1 tbsp of the soy and cook until glazed. Cool.
Spread the rice over the nori, fill with tofu and avocado and roll tight with a mat.
Slice with a wet knife.
Serve with the rest of the soy and pickled ginger.

veg.make_ahead: Bake the cupcakes up to 2 days ahead and keep airtight; top with the melted marshmallow and coconut on the day

steps.text: Beat the butter and sugar, add the eggs and vanilla and fold in the flour.
Bake in a muffin tin at 180C for 18 minutes. Cool.
Melt the marshmallows with the water.
Spread over the tops and roll in coconut so they look like snowballs.

veg.make_ahead: Fold up to 1 day ahead on a floured tray, or freeze

steps.text: Mix the mushrooms and tofu with the wombok, ginger and spring onions and season with salt.
Fold spoonfuls into the wrappers, sealing the edges with water.
Steam in batches over simmering water until cooked through.
Mix the soy, black vinegar and chilli oil for dipping.

veg.make_ahead: Batter can be made 1 hour ahead

steps.text: Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, egg and buttermilk into a thick batter in a tall glass.
Pat the frankfurts dry and push each onto a stick.
Heat the oil to 180C in a deep pot.
Dip each frankfurt in batter and fry a few at a time until golden.
Drain and serve with mustard and tomato sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Make the day before, keeps 2 days chilled

steps.text: Cut the top off the loaf and pull out most of the soft inside.
Spread the pesto inside the loaf.
Layer in the eggplant, capsicum, mozzarella, spinach, artichokes and tomatoes, pressing each layer down.
Put the lid back on, wrap tightly in plastic wrap and press under a heavy pot in the fridge overnight.
Cut into wedges to serve.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, airtight

steps.text: Line a square tray with baking paper.
Melt the butter and marshmallows together over low heat.
Stir through the puffed rice until well coated.
Press firmly into the tray and leave to set.
Cut into neat cubes and stack into towers.

veg.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Fry the sausages in the oil until browned.
Push the sausages aside, add the smoked tofu and tomatoes and cook until the tofu is crisp at the edges.
Crack in the eggs and fry until the whites set.
Toast and butter the bread.
Load up the plates and pass them down the table.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Juice the apples with a squeeze of lemon.
Whisk the sugar and agar into the juice, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes.
Pour into small glasses and chill until set.
Sprinkle with popping candy just before serving.

veg.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Fry the sausages slowly in the oil in a heavy pan until sticky and browned.
Fry the onions in the butter until golden.
Fill the rolls with sausage and onions and add a good squirt of brown sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Best served warm

steps.text: Fry the sliced sausage in the oil in a hot pan until crisp.
Add the honey and chilli flakes and cook until sticky.
Spear onto toothpicks with cubes of cheddar.

veg.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Grill the haloumi and tomatoes until golden.
Melt the butter for frying in a pan and fry the mushrooms until golden.
Toast the bread and spread with the butter for the toast and the marmalade.
Serve on a big platter.

veg.n: Steward's roast king oyster mushrooms and grapes
veg.make_ahead: Best served warm

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Score the cut side of the mushrooms and rub with butter, thyme and salt.
Roast for 25 minutes until golden and tender.
Lay on a long board with the tomatoes, grapes and torn bread.

veg.make_ahead: Best made fresh, assemble just before serving

steps.text: Sear the mushrooms in the olive oil in a hot pan until browned, splash with the soy, then rest and slice thin.
Toast the baguette slices.
Top the toast with mushroom and horseradish cream.
Slice the beetroot paper thin and toss with a squeeze of lemon. Top the blinis with creme fraiche, beetroot and chives.
Serve on black trays.
